course.title: Hydraulic Engineering
course.classroom: Room 214, Block II / Fluid Mechanics Lab
course.department: Department of Civil Engineering, CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Kengeri Campus

units.title: Boundary layer theory
units.syllabus: Boundary Layer Analysis — Assumption and concept of boundary layer theory. Boundary-layer thickness, displacement, momentum and energy thickness, laminar and turbulent boundary layers on a flat plate; Laminar sub-layer, smooth and rough boundaries. Local and average friction coefficients. Separation and Control.

units.title: Open channel flow
units.syllabus: Introduction: Comparison between open channel flow and pipe flow, geometrical parameters of a channel, classification of open channels, classification of open channel flow, Velocity Distribution of channel section. Uniform Flow: Continuity, Energy and Momentum Equations, Chezy's and Manning's formulae, Most economical section, Normal depth computation. Non-Uniform Flow: Specific energy, critical flow, Specific force, Specific depth, Critical depth, Channel Transitions. Hydraulic Jump — Theory, elements, length and height, types and applications. Discharge measurement: Venturi flume, standing wave flume, Parshall flume, Broad crested weir. Gradually Varied Flow — Dynamic equation, surface profiles, profile computation.

units.title: Impact of jets
units.syllabus: The force exerted by the jet on Stationary and Moving Plates and Vanes: Flat, Inclined and Curved. Force exerted on a series of radial vanes — Flat and Curved. Work done, power transmitted, and hydraulic efficiency. Applications to turbine runners.

units.title: Hydraulic machines
units.syllabus: Turbines: Introduction to hydraulic machines, Classification of turbines, impulse and reaction turbines. Design features, The efficiency of turbines, operating and main characteristic curves. Hydraulic Pumps: Introduction, Classification of pumps: centrifugal and reciprocating pumps, pumps in series and parallel, The efficiency of the pumps, characteristic curves, NPSH.

units.title: Computational fluid dynamics
units.syllabus: Basic Equations of fluid dynamics, Grid generation. Basics of modelling using OpenFOAM and ANSYS-Fluent. 3D Modelling of Open Channel Flow (Uniform/ Non-Uniform) on OpenFOAM and ANSYS-Fluent. Comparison of Experimental data with different CFD Models. Modelling using HEC-RAS 2D. Comparison of experimental flume data with numerical models.

labs.title: Lab Orientation, Safety Briefing & Uncertainty
labs.goal: Lab conduct, safety protocols for pumps/turbines, observation book format, and uncertainty propagation in measurements.

labs.title: Exp 1: Calibration of V-Notch (90° Triangular Notch)
labs.goal: Determine discharge coefficient Cd for a 90° notch; verify Q proportional to H^(5/2).

labs.title: Exp 2: Calibration of Rectangular / Trapezoidal Notch
labs.goal: Determine discharge coefficient Cd for a rectangular notch with Francis end contraction correction.

labs.title: Exp 3: Calibration of Ogee Spillway Crest
labs.goal: Head-discharge rating curve of an ogee spillway and observation of negative pressures at excessive heads.

labs.title: Exp 4: Calibration of Broad-Crested Weir
labs.goal: Establish critical flow on weir crest; determine Cd and modular submergence limit.

labs.title: Exp 5: Venturi Meter & Orifice Meter in Pipes
labs.goal: Differential manometer readings, piezometric lines, and head loss comparison across constriction meters.

labs.title: Exp 6: Hydraulic Coefficients of Vertical Orifice
labs.goal: Determination of contraction coefficient (Cc), velocity coefficient (Cv), and discharge coefficient (Cd).

labs.title: Exp 7: Darcy Friction Factor in Straight Pipe
labs.goal: Measure frictional head loss across pipe lengths; calculate friction factor f vs Reynolds number on Moody chart.

labs.title: Exp 8: Vane Coefficient for Flat & Hemispherical Vanes
labs.goal: Measure hydrodynamic impact force using a spring balance; verify theoretical momentum transfer equations.

labs.title: Exp 11: Performance Test on Centrifugal Pump
labs.goal: Constant speed performance test: plot Head vs Q, Shaft Power vs Q, and Efficiency vs Q; locate BEP.

labs.title: Exp 12: Working Demonstration of Pelton, Francis & Kaplan
labs.goal: Study runner construction, spear needle nozzle governing, wicket gates, and draft tube pressure recovery.

labs.title: Exp 9: Channel Model Setup in HEC-RAS 2D
labs.goal: Import channel geometry, define 2D computational mesh, assign Manning's n, and configure boundary conditions.

labs.title: Exp 10: 2D Simulation & Flume Validation
labs.goal: Run unsteady 2D hydrodynamic simulation; extract water surface profiles and compare with laboratory readings.

labs.title: Mid-Semester Practical Examination
labs.goal: Hands-on execution of flow measurement and machine performance test under exam conditions.

labs.title: Final Viva-Voce & Mini-Project Presentation
labs.goal: Submission of finalized laboratory record, team presentation, and oral defense of Mini-Project Stage III.

sessions.title: Boundary Layer Concept & Growth
sessions.hook: Prandtl's boundary layer hypothesis; laminar vs turbulent boundary layer growth over spillway chutes and ship hulls.
sessions.keywords: boundary layer laminar turbulent prandtl thickness chute hull

sessions.title: Boundary Layer Thicknesses
sessions.hook: Displacement (delta*), momentum (theta), and energy thickness (delta**); mass deficit in wind tunnels and flumes.
sessions.keywords: displacement momentum energy thickness deficit shape factor

sessions.title: Laminar Boundary Layer on Flat Plate
sessions.hook: Blasius exact solution vs von Karman momentum integral equation; boundary layer growth delta proportional to x^(1/2).
sessions.keywords: blasius laminar flat plate von karman momentum integral shear

sessions.title: Turbulent Boundary Layer & Sub-layer
sessions.hook: 1/7th power velocity profile; laminar sub-layer; Nikuradse equivalent sand grain roughness (ks); hydraulically smooth vs rough regimes.
sessions.keywords: turbulent power law sublayer nikuradse roughness smooth rough

sessions.title: Local and Average Friction Coefficients
sessions.hook: Skin friction drag computation over flat plates, bridge piers, and sluice gate faces; skin friction vs form drag.
sessions.keywords: skin friction drag coefficient local average pier sluice gate

sessions.title: Separation & Control of Boundary Layer
sessions.hook: Adverse pressure gradient (dp/dx > 0); flow detachment; vortex shedding; boundary layer control (suction, blowing, streamlining).
sessions.keywords: separation adverse pressure gradient vortex shedding suction blowing streamlining

sessions.title: Open Channel Flow vs Pipe Flow
sessions.hook: Hydraulic gradient line vs free surface; prismatic vs non-prismatic channels; steady/unsteady and uniform/non-uniform regimes.
sessions.keywords: open channel pipe flow hydraulic gradient line free surface prismatic steady

sessions.title: Velocity Distribution & Conservation Laws
sessions.hook: Isovels in rectangular and trapezoidal sections; dip phenomenon; energy correction factor (alpha) and momentum factor (beta).
sessions.keywords: velocity distribution isovels dip coriolis boussinesq energy momentum

sessions.title: Uniform Flow: Chezy's & Manning's Equations
sessions.hook: Equilibrium between gravity driving force and boundary shear stress; factors influencing Manning's n; Cowan's composite roughness.
sessions.keywords: uniform flow chezy manning roughness cowan composite resistance

sessions.title: Most Economical Channel Sections
sessions.hook: Condition for minimum wetted perimeter for given discharge: rectangular (b=2y), trapezoidal (semi-hexagon, m=1/sqrt(3)), circular.
sessions.keywords: economical section optimal trapezoidal rectangular perimeter discharge

sessions.title: Computation of Normal Depth & Solvers
sessions.hook: Iterative solution of implicit Manning's equation for trapezoidal canal design; automated Newton-Raphson solver.
sessions.keywords: normal depth newton raphson bisection implicit manning solver canal

sessions.title: Specific Energy & Critical Flow
sessions.hook: Specific energy curve E = y + V^2/(2g); critical depth yc = (q^2/g)^(1/3); Froude number criteria (Fr=1); minimum specific energy Emin = 1.5 yc.
sessions.keywords: specific energy critical flow depth froude number alternate depths

sessions.title: Specific Force & Channel Transitions
sessions.hook: Flow over upward bed humps (delta z) and channel contractions (b2 < b1); choking conditions and upstream water level backing.
sessions.keywords: specific force channel transition hump width contraction choking backing

sessions.title: Hydraulic Jump Theory & Dissipation
sessions.hook: Belanger momentum balance; conjugate depths y2/y1 = 0.5*(sqrt(1+8Fr1^2)-1); jump classification; stilling basin design and energy loss.
sessions.keywords: hydraulic jump belanger sequent depths energy dissipation stilling basin

sessions.title: Discharge Measurement in Channels
sessions.hook: Critical flow meters: Venturi flumes, Standing wave flumes, Parshall flumes, and broad-crested weirs; head-discharge calibration.
sessions.lab: Linked with L02, L03, L04, L05
sessions.keywords: flow measurement venturi flume standing wave parshall weir calibration

sessions.title: Gradually Varied Flow & Surface Profiles
sessions.hook: Dynamic equation dy/dx = (S0 - Sf)/(1 - Fr^2); 12 surface profiles (M1, M2, M3, S1, S2, S3, C, H, A); Direct Step method calculation.
sessions.keywords: gradually varied flow gvf dynamic equation direct step profile backwater drawdown

sessions.title: Impulse-Momentum & Stationary Vertical Plate
sessions.hook: Newton's second law for continuous fluid flow; normal hydrodynamic force Fn = rho*a*V^2; pressure head vs velocity head conversion.
sessions.keywords: impulse momentum stationary plate normal force hydrodynamic jet nozzle

sessions.title: Jet Impact on Inclined Flat Plate
sessions.hook: Normal force Fn = rho*a*V^2*sin(theta); split ratio of flow discharge along forward and backward directions; resolving force components.
sessions.keywords: inclined plate normal force discharge split ratio forward backward

sessions.title: Jet Impact on Stationary Curved Vanes
sessions.hook: Symmetrical vs unsymmetrical vanes; turning angles (theta); force doubling in hemispherical cup (Fn = 2*rho*a*V^2); Pelton bucket principle.
sessions.keywords: curved vane hemispherical cup deflection angle pelton bucket force

sessions.title: Jet Impinging on Moving Flat Plates
sessions.hook: Relative velocity Vr = (V - u); mass flow intercepted by moving plate m = rho*a*(V - u); power transmission and theoretical efficiency cap (29.6%).
sessions.keywords: moving flat plate relative velocity mass intercepted work done efficiency

sessions.title: Moving Curved Vanes & Velocity Triangles
sessions.hook: Inlet and outlet velocity triangles; whirl velocity components (Vw1, Vw2); work done per second W = rho*a*Vr1*(Vw1 +- Vw2)*u; hydraulic efficiency.
sessions.keywords: moving curved vane velocity triangles whirl velocity work done efficiency

sessions.title: Numerical Analysis on Plates & Vanes
sessions.hook: Comparative analysis of force, work done, and kinetic energy extraction across flat, inclined, and curved geometries.
sessions.keywords: numerical force work power energy comparison plate vane

sessions.title: Series of Flat Radial Vanes
sessions.hook: Continuous mass flow intercepted m = rho*a*V; maximum efficiency condition u = V/2 yielding eta_max = 50%; wheel torque calculation.
sessions.keywords: series flat vanes wheel torque power maximum efficiency

sessions.title: Series of Curved Radial Vanes
sessions.hook: Full mass rate m = rho*a*V; exit velocity vector; maximum theoretical efficiency eta_max = (1 + cos(phi))/2 approaching 100% in ideal buckets.
sessions.keywords: series curved vanes wheel runner maximum efficiency exit vector

sessions.title: Numerical Workshop: Velocity Triangles
sessions.hook: Step-by-step vector construction and calculation of power delivered to the runner for specified nozzle diameters and heads.
sessions.keywords: numerical workshop velocity triangles runner power torque

sessions.title: Applications to Turbine Runners
sessions.hook: Bridging jet mechanics to impulse and reaction turbine runner design; Euler's turbine equation derivation.
sessions.keywords: turbine runner euler equation impulse reaction angular momentum

sessions.title: Introduction to Turbines & Classification
sessions.hook: Gross head vs net head; hydraulic, mechanical, volumetric, and overall efficiency; selection charts: Pelton vs Francis vs Kaplan.
sessions.keywords: turbines classification impulse reaction pelton francis kaplan gross net head

sessions.title: Pelton Wheel Components & Working
sessions.hook: Spear needle nozzle governing; splitter edge angle (165 deg); bucket dimensions; pitch diameter and jet ratio (m = D/d).
sessions.keywords: pelton wheel spear needle nozzle splitter bucket jet ratio

sessions.title: Pelton Wheel Sizing & Sizing Problems
sessions.hook: Number of buckets (Taygun formula z = 15 + 0.5m); wheel speed N = 60*u/(pi*D); power generated and efficiency optimization.
sessions.keywords: pelton design sizing taygun buckets runner speed power

sessions.title: Francis Turbine: Inward Flow Reaction
sessions.hook: Spiral casing, guide vanes (wicket gates), runner blades, and radial/mixed discharge; radial discharge condition at outlet (alpha2 = 90 deg).
sessions.keywords: francis turbine reaction spiral casing guide vanes wicket gates runner

sessions.title: Kaplan & Propeller Turbines & Draft Tubes
sessions.hook: Axial flow reaction turbine; adjustable runner blades; draft tube theory and pressure recovery efficiency.
sessions.keywords: kaplan propeller axial flow draft tube pressure recovery cavitation

sessions.title: Specific Speed & Unit Quantities
sessions.hook: Dimensionless parameters; specific speed Ns = N*sqrt(P)/H^(5/4); unit speed Nu, unit discharge Qu, unit power Pu for scale modeling.
sessions.keywords: specific speed unit quantities model testing affinity laws scale

sessions.title: Turbine Characteristic Curves & Cavitation
sessions.hook: Main, operating, and Muschel curves (constant efficiency contours); Thoma's cavitation factor (sigma); runaway speed protection.
sessions.keywords: characteristic curves muschel curves thoma cavitation runaway speed

sessions.title: Centrifugal Pumps: Classification & Working
sessions.hook: Impeller types (backward curved, radial, forward curved); volute casing and vortex chamber; priming necessity; manometric head Hm.
sessions.keywords: centrifugal pump impeller volute vortex priming manometric head

sessions.title: Heads, Work Done & Pump Efficiencies
sessions.hook: Manometric efficiency, mechanical efficiency, overall efficiency; Euler head He = (Vw2*u2)/g; minimum starting speed calculation.
sessions.keywords: pump heads work done manometric efficiency euler head starting speed

sessions.title: Pumps in Series/Parallel, Curves & NPSH
sessions.hook: System-head curve matching: H_sys = H_static + K*Q^2; multi-stage pumps (head addition) vs parallel sets (discharge addition); NPSH_avail > NPSH_req.
sessions.keywords: pumps series parallel system curve duty point npsh cavitation

sessions.title: Reciprocating Pumps: Principles & Slip
sessions.hook: Positive displacement mechanics; theoretical vs actual discharge; slip and negative slip; air vessels for smoothing discharge fluctuation.
sessions.keywords: reciprocating pump positive displacement slip air vessel indicator diagram

sessions.title: Introduction to CFD & Governing Equations
sessions.hook: Continuity (mass conservation), Navier-Stokes (momentum conservation), and energy equations; Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS).
sessions.keywords: cfd governing equations continuity navier stokes rans turbulence

sessions.title: Discretisation Methods & Grid Generation
sessions.hook: Finite Difference (FDM), Finite Volume (FVM); structured vs unstructured meshing; cell skewness, aspect ratio, and boundary layer prism inflation.
sessions.keywords: discretisation fdm fvm grid generation mesh skewness aspect ratio

sessions.title: Initial & Boundary Conditions & Turbulence
sessions.hook: Inlet velocity, pressure outlet, no-slip walls, symmetry planes; standard k-epsilon, k-omega SST turbulence models; y+ wall resolution.
sessions.keywords: boundary conditions inlet outlet no slip k epsilon k omega y plus

sessions.title: OpenFOAM & SimFlow: Meshing & interFoam VOF
sessions.hook: Volume of Fluid (VOF) multiphase modelling for open channels; snappyHexMesh; tracking water-air free surface interfaces.
sessions.keywords: openfoam simflow interfoam vof multiphase snappyhexmesh free surface

sessions.title: ANSYS-Fluent Workflow & HEC-RAS 2D Intro
sessions.hook: HEC-RAS 2D subgrid bathymetry approach; Diffusion Wave equation vs Full 2D Shallow Water Equations (SWE); comparison with 3D CFD.
sessions.keywords: fluent hecras 2d shallow water diffusion wave subgrid bathymetry

sessions.title: Uniform Open Channel Flow in HEC-RAS 2D
sessions.hook: Terrain import, 2D flow area polygon, boundary hydrographs; simulated normal depth and bed shear stress validation against Manning's equation.
sessions.keywords: hecras 2d uniform flow normal depth bed shear stress validation

sessions.title: Non-Uniform Flow & Hydraulic Jump Simulation
sessions.hook: Simulating flow over an ogee weir and subsequent hydraulic jump in HEC-RAS 2D / SimFlow; water surface profile tracking.
sessions.keywords: hecras 2d ogee weir hydraulic jump water surface non uniform

sessions.title: Validation: CFD vs Flume & Capstone Defense
sessions.hook: Computing Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and percentage error between experimental readings, 1D analytical theory, and 2D/3D numerical models.
sessions.keywords: validation rmse error analysis flume comparison capstone defense
